meta.title: Harbor Strike
supplies: Pencil and paper, or markers for tracks
Small tokens or the printed counter sheet

credits.source: Original fictional setting for this example

brief.conflict: A fictional port city where the Port Authority, the Dockers' Union and the armed Red Hand fight over the docks.

overview.period: A fictional strike season of about two years.

claims.text: The setting is fictional. It shows the tool with more than two factions.

factions.name: Port Authority
factions.role: Holds the docks and the customs posts. Wins by keeping districts on its side.

factions.name: Red Hand
factions.role: A small armed group in the back streets. Wins by turning districts against the Authority.

factions.name: Dockers' Union
factions.role: Organizes strikes and never fights. Wins by turning districts against the Authority and opening union offices.

sequence.firstActor: The first two Eligible factions in the card's faction order act, in that order. If only one faction is Eligible, it acts alone.

eligibilityAfter.bothIneligibleResult: If every faction would be Ineligible, all factions become Eligible.

phases.name: Victory check
phases.text: Compute each faction's victory score. A faction above its threshold wins at once. After the final Reckoning the highest margin wins.

phases.name: Income
phases.text: Each faction gains Resources. The Strike Fund rises by 1.

text.overview: A fictional strike season of about two years. A fictional port city where the Port Authority, the Dockers' Union and the armed Red Hand fight over the docks.

actions.name: Deploy
actions.plain: In each chosen space, place up to 2 Troops from Available.

actions.name: Sweep
actions.plain: In each chosen space with a underground Guerrillas, move up to 3 Troops in from adjacent spaces. Then flip one underground Guerrillas to active for each Troops there.

actions.name: Pressure
actions.plain: In one space with 2 or more Troops, shift opinion one step toward Support.

actions.name: Recruit
actions.plain: In each chosen space with a Guerrillas or Base, place 2 Guerrillas if a Base is there, otherwise 1.

actions.name: Strike
actions.plain: In one chosen space with Guerrillas and Troops, roll one die. On a roll at or below the number of Guerrillas there, remove 1 Troops. Then flip all underground Guerrillas there to active.

actions.name: Ambush
actions.plain: In one space with a underground Guerrillas and an enemy Troops, remove 1 Troops. The Guerrillas stays underground.

actions.name: Campaign
actions.plain: In each chosen space, shift opinion one step toward Opposition.

actions.name: Mobilize
actions.plain: In each chosen space with Population 1 or more, place 1 Activists from Available.

actions.name: Propaganda
actions.plain: In one space, shift opinion one step toward Opposition.

actions.name: Walkout
actions.plain: Pay 2 Strike Fund. Shift opinion 1 step toward Opposition. Flip all Activists from Underground to Active.
actions.purpose: Turn opinion with a strike; Activists are exposed.

sides.label: Extra patrols
sides.text: Place 2 Troops from Available in a chosen space.

sides.label: Picket lines
sides.text: Place 2 Activists from Available in a chosen space.

sides.label: Rebuild the quay
sides.text: Shift opinion 1 step toward Support in a chosen space.

sides.label: Blame the Authority
sides.text: Shift opinion 1 step toward Opposition in a chosen space.

sides.label: Names given
sides.text: Remove 2 Guerrillas in a chosen space to Available.

sides.label: Soup kitchens
sides.text: Shift opinion 1 step toward Support in a chosen space.

sides.label: March on City Hall
sides.text: Shift opinion 1 step toward Opposition in a chosen space.

preparation.text: Make two piles of Event cards. Shuffle Reckoning into the bottom half of pile 1. Put Final Reckoning at the bottom of pile 2. Put pile 1 on top of pile 2.

perFaction.plain: Support Pop: total Pop of spaces at Support.
Opposition Pop plus Base on the map.
Opposition Pop plus Office on the map.

victory.checkAt: Each Reckoning card, in the victory check phase.
victory.finalScoring: After the final Reckoning card, the faction with the highest margin (score minus threshold) wins.
tieBreaks: The faction earlier in the faction list wins a tie.

measures.name: Leading enemy margin
measures.plain: The highest victory margin among the enemies. Near 0 means an enemy is close to winning.

eventPolicy.plain: Play the unshaded side if the Event has an effect.

overrides.plain: Never play this Event: it helps the other side more.

nodes.text: Deploy in 1 space (priority table PA-1), against the enemy chosen by its enemy table.

linked.skipText: Skip Pressure if Resources are below 1 or no space qualifies.

steps.text: A space with the target's pieces.
An enemy that is not on the state side.

randomization.eligibleSet: All spaces still tied after the lettered tie-breaks, in alphabetical order of space name.
randomization.procedure: Roll one die. With N tied spaces, divide the faces into N equal groups in list order and use the group the roll falls in.
